combo.description: Use your Q then E Flash to stun your enemy, then W, W and R to finish.
Use your Q then W and W again before using your E, the Flash and R your target!
Sneak in a quick Q before using your R and then scatter those spheres with your E!
Lead with your Q then AA, W and W again. Then E AA, R, AA, AA and Q again to finish.
Start with your Q and E combo, then W, W and R to take them down.
Start with a Q, then W, W again and then E.
Use your Q and E quickly before following up with a W, W and AA to finish.
Use your Q, then W, W again and finish with your E.
Use your Q, then AA, W, AA and W again before using your E. Then, fire off a few more auto atacks before a final Q.
To poke in lane Q then E and W to pick up an orb or minion then instantly W.
